description: Renovate pull requests are not merged as opened: the landing pipeline takes each one over on a signed-off fix/renovate-<number> branch with its own pull request, and that pull request runs the full CI and every required check.

CI on the Renovate pull request itself is therefore skipped: the Go tests, the Platform Neutrality legs, the preset builds, the security scan and the documentation site skip a pull request that renovate[bot] opened from a branch starting with renovate/ (docs/guides/contributing.md). The DCO and REUSE gate, the configuration validation and Documentation Governance still run, and a person's pull request from a renovate/ branch runs every job.

rebaseWhen conflicted: a branch is rebased only when it conflicts with main. The default, auto, rebases every open branch whenever main moves, because the ruleset requires up-to-date branches, and those runs filled every runner.
automerge false everywhere: a skipped required check reports success, so an automerging rule could merge a pull request nothing verified.

customManagers.description: The pinned Node release the gate runs the devcontainer CLI with. Renovate moves the version; the per-platform checksums beside it must then be refreshed from the release's SHASUMS256.txt (PRAETOR_UPDATE_NODE_PINS=1 go test ./internal/devcontainer -run TestPinnedNodeMatchesTheRelease), and that test fails the branch until they are.

The renovate release CI validates this file with: the exact RENOVATE_VERSION pin in .github/workflows/ci.yml. An update that cannot be installed or that rejects this configuration fails on its own pull request (#709).

Reviewed DevContainer default images: the Reviewed at line directly above DefaultBuilderImage and DefaultBaseImage in internal/devcontainer/bootstrap.go is each image's one pin, tag included, and the pattern is devcontainer.ReviewedPinPattern. Renovate looks the digest up under that tag, never as latest, and one update moves the line and the digest-only constant together. The takeover then runs praetorctl devcontainer bump, which records the replaced digest in internal/devcontainer/prior-images.json and regenerates and verifies the bundle (#323).

DevContainer features: the archetype and facet catalog selects them and devcontainer.json is generated from it, so feature updates move the catalog. Every file naming one feature changes in one branch, as ResolveDevContainerFeatures requires one reference per feature; the takeover re-pins .standards.lock and regenerates the bundle, as #705 did.
DevContainer features: the Node.js version option of the node feature in the catalog, which Renovate's devcontainer manager read from devcontainer.json before the bundle was excluded.

packageRules.description: Documentation gate: audit locks .github/workflows/praetor-docs.yml, here and in every adopted repository, to the template in tools/markdownlint/assets.go. The github-actions manager reads both, and one branch moves their SHA pins and release comments together. The Renovate pull request skips the Go tests and the audit, so its takeover pull request fails CI until the outgoing workflow text is recorded in priorDigests and internal/managedasset/testdata/shipped (docs/guides/documentation-governance.md), which lets adopters holding it still refresh without --force.

API compatibility gate: audit locks .github/workflows/praetor-api.yml, here and in every adopted repository, to the template in tools/apicompat/assets.go. The github-actions manager reads both, and one branch moves their SHA pins and release comments together. The branch fails CI until the outgoing workflow text is recorded in priorDigests and internal/managedasset/testdata/shipped (docs/guides/api-compatibility.md), so adopters holding it still refresh without --force.
Starlight preset: package.json stays on exact versions, package-lock.json moves with them, and CI builds the preset from the lock with npm ci.
MkDocs preset: requirements.txt is the hashed lock the pip-compile manager compiles from requirements.in, so pip_requirements must not rewrite it on its own.
MkDocs preset: requirements.in pins move together, the hashed lock is recompiled, and CI installs it with --require-hashes.

VS Code extension: @types/vscode moves only with engines.vscode. vsce refuses host types newer than the engine floor, and the ^1.107.0 floor keeps Antigravity IDE and other trailing VS Code forks on the update path (editors/vscode/README.md, Minimum host; editors/vscode/src/setup.test.ts). Raising the floor is a deliberate change made by hand.
Gate devcontainer CLI: package.json pins @devcontainers/cli exactly and package-lock.json moves with it; the gate installs it from the embedded lock with npm ci (internal/devcontainer/cli.go).
Gate devcontainer CLI: the Node release it runs on stays on the Node 24 line the gate pins.
tools/figures React cluster: keep React and its typings together.
Hook lint toolchain: requirements.txt is the hashed lock the pip-compile manager compiles from requirements.in, so pip_requirements must not rewrite it on its own.
Hook lint toolchain: black, flake8 and yamllint pins move together, the hashed lock is recompiled, and CI installs it with --require-hashes for make hooks-lint and the portability job's yamllint.

Generated DevContainer bundle: praetorctl devcontainer renders devcontainer.json and Dockerfile.praetor from the reviewed pins and the catalog, and bundle verification rejects any edit, so no manager updates them. Image updates come through the reviewed-pin custom manager and feature updates through the catalog custom managers (#323, #696).

Reviewed DevContainer images: the builder pin in internal/devcontainer/bootstrap.go and the FROM line of docker/dev/Dockerfile name one image, so one branch moves both, with the base pin, and the takeover runs one praetorctl devcontainer bump for it.
